'''watch your ste... o well. watch your step AND THAT ASTEROID!!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[watch your ste... o well.]]
* '''Published:''' 25 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 WYS well. LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a deck I put together for fun because I had a unused objective lying around so I put a deck together and to my surprise it sorta worked I’ve been updating it and I would like input.
Thanks

I start with:
Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough and the stuff that goes with it
Heading For the Medical Frigate
Colo claw fish
Squadron Assignments
Superficial Damage
try to get asteroid sanctuary and kessel runs going lure the enemy into the asteroid fields and take them out with extra destinies.
